codeReview.summary: Clean removal of 22 inline offset/byte comments from parse functions in status.rs (15 `// Offset N`) and information.rs (7 `// Bytes N`). Layout diagrams and field doc comments preserved as canonical. Restating doc comments removed from fault.rs (days_ago, hour, minute, set_temperature, sensor_a_temp, sensor_b_temp) and information.rs (heater_voltage, heater_type). Fault.rs field docs enhanced with protocol context (fault_count → 'entries in controller fault log', entry_number → '1-based sequential index', message_code → cross-ref to FaultCode, flags → 'bitfield encoding'). All 130 existing tests pass. No behavioral changes.

issues.description: Borderline restating doc comments: `/// Duration hours` on `duration_hours` and `/// Duration minutes` on `duration_minutes`. These add minimal info beyond the field name. However, the feature description listed filter.rs as an affected file and the worker correctly identified it had no inline offset comments needing removal, so the doc comment issue is minor. The field names are already reasonably self-documenting.

summary: PASS. The feature successfully removes all triple-documented protocol offsets from parse functions in status.rs, fault.rs, filter.rs, and information.rs.
